scope.visual: 8 fixed DexYCB val clips from24; 210 fitted MANO states; same clip32 and counts. GT crop/fixed camera gauge; no independent MoCap, automatic detector or moving ego SLAM.
scope.motion: Same per-source fixed16 windows at initial D37 best and current TWM; equal-source macro per eligible metric; counts checked. Not older D37 256-window evaluation.
scope.meanings: raw is current trainable HaWoR; candidate is final-round adapter output before last TWM; final is last TWM output; root/finger are rotation geodesic degrees, not MPJPE.
scope.coverage: 90pct 3D anchor Gaussian ellipsoid, chi-square3 threshold6.2514; std is mean anchor-axis std, uncertainty uncalibrated.
scope.history: Each fixed val clip restarts empty history; at most32 own-history frames with official16-frame HaWoR lookahead. Not long-recording causal closed-loop.
scope.training_change: Read-only log/metadata analysis; did not change training, weights, losses or schedule.

evaluation_protocol.reference: DexYCB official fitted MANO/joint annotation, s0 recording split; 16 train/8 val recordings, two subjects. Source manifest SHA in identity.
evaluation_protocol.coordinates: Fixed camera836212060125 world gauge, translation meters; wrist errors exported in mm; root/global and finger/local SO(3) geodesic degrees.
evaluation_protocol.motion_macro: Equal mean across eligible sources per metric, with counts and source membership stored; counts unchanged versus baseline.
evaluation_protocol.candidate_interpretation: Candidate is final adapter output conditioned on first TWM refinement and prior-frame final history. Candidate-to-final compares last TWM refinement only, not whole-TWM contribution.
evaluation_protocol.nll: Visual full-state density NLL, no divide51; negative values allowed.
evaluation_protocol.best: Best among trained checkpoints under mixed geometry score; initialized step0 kept separately.
